### GitHub Projects Board Creation
Since GitHub CLI has permission limitations for creating project boards, please use the web UI:

#### Quick Guide:
1. Go to: https://github.com/deokhwajeong?tab=projects
2. Click **"New project"**
3. Select **"Board"** template
4. Name: `OCR Enhancement 2026`
5. Description: `Receipt OCR recognition accuracy 85% + mobile optimization (2026.01.16 ~ 2026.03.15)`
6. Click **Create**

#### Detailed Guide:
See **[CREATE_PROJECT_GUIDE.md](CREATE_PROJECT_GUIDE.md)** for step-by-step instructions

## 📞 Communication

### Issue Reporting
Use GitHub Issues with appropriate labels:
- Bugs: `bug` + `ocr`
- Features: `enhancement` + `feature`
- Questions: Create discussion

### Code Review
- All PRs require review
- OCR changes require test cases
- Documentation updates mandatory for new features

### Weekly Sync
- **When**: Every Friday
- **What**: Progress review, metrics check, blocker resolution
- **Where**: GitHub Projects board
